title: Vulnerabilities in PrestaHelp phsuperpack module for PrestaShop
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 2 vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-114346 and CVE-2026-114347) found in PrestaHelp phsuperpack module for PrestaShop. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in PrestaHelp phsuperpack module for PrestaShop | CERT Polska
